post.description: Revoke all of the owner's browser sessions, retaining this machine credential. A key has no browser session to exempt.
Revoke this machine API key and its secret. Subsequent calls using it are unauthorized; browser sessions are unchanged.

get.description: Read authorized workspace members, invitations and the owner's current management role.

post.description: Create an invitation within the delegated owner's role authority. Returns a private sign-in link; does not send email.

delete.description: Revoke a pending invitation in the authorized workspace.

patch.description: Change a member role without exceeding the owner's authority or removing the last active administrator.

delete.description: Remove workspace access, preserving the account, other memberships and authored resources. Protects the last administrator.

post.description: An instance-admin owner may disable or enable an account belonging exclusively to the authorized workspace. Shared/foreign identities and last administrators are protected.
